_README: Reference values for the deterministic regression tests.
These come from `cnetml --mode 2`, which scores one supplied tree with
no RNG and no tree search, so it is reproducible to the digit. They are
the refactoring insurance the project plan calls for: if a change to the
likelihood code moves these numbers, that is a change in scientific
behaviour and needs to be a deliberate one.
Regenerate with tests/regenerate_fixtures.sh, and only ever commit a new
value together with the reason it changed.
Note cnetml prints 6 significant figures, so tests compare with a
relative tolerance of 1e-5 rather than for equality.
